roads.name: Santa Fe Parkway
words: Properly twisty: 43 curves in 7.8 miles, about 6 a mile.
The 2 miles at the north end are tamer, with about 4 side roads a mile.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 87 to 123 ft, with 78 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 93°F.
Surface not confirmed.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.84 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
